scope: Run STM goal/PWM integration candidate or saved source on a native PC.
checks: PASS UART -> mapper -> motor: straight +144/+150 and -140/-150; rounding at partial/low input; pure-turn200, mixed150 and zero
PASS 300ms timeout, no CMD-only rearm, DISARM and ESTOP stop at turn200
PASS mapper cap201 rejected; signed +/-201 and raw201 stop both outputs
PASS snapshot: 16/32-bit wrap, reverse, no CPS-window mutation, null/overflow rejection
PASS main sampling: count every5ms, CPS every100ms, TIM3 sign, invalid normalization, no USB wait
PASS ARM/re-ARM: wait for post-ARM5ms snapshot, preserve accumulated counts and numeric TEL contract
PASS async TX: frame buffer lifetime, wrong-UART callback, FIFO ACK priority, latest pending TEL
PASS critical queue overflow: stop and latch rearm refusal; active memory remains intact
PASS TX missing completion: deadline100ms stops and latches
PASS HAL TX ERROR/BUSY: immediate latched stop
PASS command timeout and E-stop enforced while wire transfer is active; E-stop reason preserved
PASS old pending TEL discarded; RX processing bounded64bytes per poll; no runtime blocking TX
PASS timing candidate: synthetic PC execution only, no MCU build or motion
PASS optional distance suffix: ordinary CMD unchanged; malformed/range/direction/order rejected
PASS all four targets: independent cutoff, relative baseline, immutable goal, no restart after reached
PASS right reaches first: right cutoff held while left finishes
PASS first target requires fresh post-ARM100ms stationary baseline
PASS release/zero cancels without autonomous resume; new nonzero command requires rearm
PASS changed goal/manual PWM cannot bypass distance latch; duplicate ARM cannot rewind; new ARM resets idle
PASS invalid/stale/gapped/reversed/wrong-ARM sample cuts both outputs and disarms
PASS keepalive cannot extend500ms no-progress or3000ms total-run deadline
PASS distance run preserves timeout/E-stop/DISARM immediate stop and original reasons
PASS transport fault cancels distance immediately without bypassing TX rearm latch
PASS STM distance integration candidate only; ESP/browser and board motion remain pending
limitations: Host execution, not an STM board build or measured stop-time/distance result
ESP request parser/executor and browser distance controls not wired yet
Goal-reached means cutoff; coasting counts and actual link travel must be measured
